title: UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Online Form 2026
intro: Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a notification for the recruitment of Platoon Commander / Block Organizer posts on the official website. This recruitment has been issued for 295 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Recruitment 2026 has started on 16 June 2026, and candidates can apply until 06 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UPSSSC Platoon Commander / Block Organizer Recruitment 2026 given below.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
